local_validation.summary: All available local gates pass for the repaired repository-owned auto-merge and remediation policy: 147 GitHub helper tests, 59 focused auto-merge/coordinator/workflow-policy tests, 29 checksum-verified actionlint and workflow-policy tests, Python compilation, coordinator-to-consumer policy binding, eligible non-stable-base and stable-base-rejection coverage, a full staging findings-to-claim-to-validator-to-publisher regression, a real exact-old-OID receive-pack race with an unrelated Unicode ref, deterministic workflow materialization, canonical/live byte identity, JSON parsing, public-safety and secret-pattern scans, and whitespace checks. The local Speculoos binary is unavailable, so independent hosted Speculoos evidence remains required after publication.

github_checks.summary: PR #95 remains open at hosted head 80c7b328d6ce0ddad26df2db2358a7cda53b79ba. The exact-head Pullfrog run succeeded but pullfrog-approval failed on two P2 findings: unrelated Unicode refs could block receive-pack discovery, and non-dev remediation policy was not carried into candidate validation and publication. Both are repaired locally and require guarded publication plus fresh exact-head hosted checks.

pullfrog_review.summary: Pullfrog review 5678460231 found that receive-pack discovery ASCII-decoded arbitrary ref names and that newly admitted non-dev bases were not carried through the remediation validator and publisher. The local repair preserves advertised ref-name bytes while validating object IDs and capabilities separately, and digest-binds the coordinator's exact default/protected-ref policy into the claim for every downstream guard. Fresh hosted Pullfrog review and approval remain required.

speculoos_evidence.summary: Independent hosted Speculoos evidence is required on the new exact head and cannot be replaced by Pullfrog output.

self_managed.summary: Not accepted as normal or fallback review evidence.

mergeguez_review.summary: Mergeguez is not a reviewer. It remains the manual publication and merge broker; automatic feature-to-dev merge is owned separately by the repository exact-head GitHub Actions gate, while stable-branch merge stays human-authorized.
